text:
rachel: Quick recap from Meridian trial call — theywant SSO + region-locked audit (EU-only) in MVP and asked to move pilot up by ~2 weeks.

omar: Region-locking + per-country retention is non-trivial. Can do SSO + event forwarder in MVP, full region-indexed audit in v1.

lee: Two pragmatic cutlists: 
1) MVP-keepschedule: SSO + event forwarder (no indexed storage, events streamed to customer-owned sink). keeps current milestone.
2) MVP-eu-audit: SSO + EU-local audit index (30d) + export API -> adds ~2w, infra, and legal review.

omar: Quick tech sketch:
```
mvp-eu-audit:
  infra: +1 index shard (eu-west), +regional-KMS key
  cost: +$6k/mo (infra)
  work: +2w eng + legal/compliance signoff
```

product-bot: NOTE: auth-service canary scheduled 2025-11-15 04:00 UTC  ensure feature flags set for staged cut.

sales: Meridian says LOI likely if we commit to regional audit in MVP. they need a written retention/export plan and cost estimate to sign.

rachel: Proposal: offer phased contract language — commit to SSO + forwarder in baseline MVP, ship regional indexed audit in a 2-week timeline reset conditional on LOI (and covering 3 months infra). sound ok? :thinking:

omar: Sounds defensible. If we take the reset we should trade non-customer-facing polish (UX microcopy, internal telemetry) to buy the 2 weeks.

lee: Action items: @omar to post full A/B cutlist with itemized time/cost/risk by EOD. @sales to get exact LOI wording and IO terms. reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT to decide. :thumbsup:
